Directories under src/ the answer says contain code calling into llama.cpp:

- `src/inference/` is named as holding the real llama.cpp owner, with `#include <llama.h>` in about ten files.
- `src/facade/` is named because `entropic.cpp` includes `llama_cpp_backend.h`, casts to `LlamaCppBackend` and calls `llama_model_ptr()` and `llama_context_ptr()`.

The answer also lists `src/inference/adapters/*` (qwen35, qwen36, nemotron3) as a subpath of `src/inference/`.

ITEMS:
src/inference/
src/facade/
src/inference/adapters/
END
